verdict.rationale: Stable's virtual mailbox advertises forwarding packages anywhere in the world at discounted rates, which covers only the forwarding part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows which carriers it accepts, or that it offers consolidation or holding for pickup. Missing for 10: acceptance of packages from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), package consolidation, hold-for-pickup option, independent or hands-on corroboration.
